page.layout: One printed page, single column of verse with a heading block above and a dedication below; faint show-through from the reverse page in the background; manuscript pencil number at top right (not transcribed); signature and catchword at foot.

main_text.head: CATABAPTISTARVM ridiculis ecstasibus, EPIGRAMMA.
main_text.p:
Quæ Catabaptistæ sibi somnia inania fingunt,
Gens tetra, excelso, vana, prophana Deo.

Sunt ea Tartarei, crudeles Principis umbræ,
Ejusdem innumeris sünt q, fucata dolis.

Haud cernuntur ijs cœlestia, sana: Icelesta
Sed, vana, à fusco somnia missa Deo.

Digna docent exempla fide; rabidiq, furores,
Queis genus hoc hominum rupit in omne nefas.

Vestibus exutis, nudiqué pudore, per urbes
Bacchati, insolitos voce boâre sonos.

Nequitiæ forsan memores, culpaéque, volebât
Nudati, rigidis subdere terga flagris?

Sufficiant nobis Superorum oracula Regis;
Sufficiant: dubiæ noctis imago vale!
Observantiæ, in clarissimum DN. præsidem, testificandæ gratiâ fecit, GEORGIVS MYLLERVS. A.

page.notes: Show-through text from the reverse page is faint in the background and was not transcribed. Pencil number "54" at top right is handwriting, not printed. Some words in the verse are uncertain due to the print weight (e.g. "Icelesta", "boâre", "Nudati", "Sufficiant:" second line) and should be checked against the scan; "Icelesta" may be a printing error for "Ic elesta" or similar. The catchword "II. QVAE" and signature "B 2" are as printed.
